signConfig.label: REBEL ARCADE
signConfig.sub: Enter if you are up for the challenge
signConfig.desc: The elders once believed war would decide the fate of the colony. They were wrong. The future would be decided by those who could master both the sword… and the game.

signConfig.label: BUILDER
signConfig.desc:
Step into the Overlay Forge.
Transform your Rebel Ant into something uniquely yours.
Add effects, layers, and identity to your NFT built by you, owned by you.
This isn’t just art… it’s your signature in the colony.

signConfig.label: LIBRARY
signConfig.desc: A sacred Japanese-style library dojo where the history of the Rebel Ants Universe is preserved. Explore ancient scrolls, faction lore, legendary collectibles, NFT displays, and the stories that shaped the colony. 🐜📚

signConfig.label: HUB VILLAGE
signConfig.desc: Here you will interact with various Ashigarus, find them all and complete all quests.
